result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. The full `mvn -q -o test` run passes. No existing test covers `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion`, and I didn't add one, so your T-1 to T-5 example hasn't been run.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. Its `ORDER BY` now uses the same priority ranking as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`. I also updated the method's Javadoc to describe the new order. Closed tickets and tickets from other regions are filtered out exactly as before.
